lines.say: Yo, what's up guys? I'm Hark's AI.
lines.tts: Yo, what's up guys? I'm Hark's A I.

lines.say: Hark is a Software Engineer at SSW. The real Hark is busy being the High Priest of Vibe Coders.
lines.tts: Hark is a Software Engineer at S S W. The real Hark is busy being the High Priest of Vibe Coders.

lines.say: Today I'll show you how Claude Code and ElevenLabs can clone your voice, so your done videos make themselves.
lines.tts: Today I'll show you how Claude Code and ElevenLabs can clone your voice, so your done videos make themselves.

lines.say: Let's jump in.
Here's what you get. A full SSW done video, made from one prompt, in your own voice.
lines.tts: Here's what you get. A full S S W done video, made from one prompt, in your own voice.

lines.say: Step one. Go to elevenlabs.io and create an account.
lines.tts: Step one. Go to elevenlabs dot io and create an account.

lines.say: You can sign up with Google, or just your email.
Step two. Pick a plan.
The free plan can't clone voices, so go for Starter. It's the cheapest plan with Instant Voice Cloning.
It's $6 a month. When Hark signed up, the first month was $1. Basically free vibes.
lines.tts: It's six dollars a month. When Hark signed up, the first month was one dollar. Basically free vibes.

lines.say: Step three. Create an API key.
In the side panel, go to Developers, then API Keys, and click Create Key.
Give it a name you'll remember. Hark called his done-videos, so future Hark knows exactly what it's for.
lines.tts: Give it a name you'll remember. Hark called his done videos, so future Hark knows exactly what it's for.

lines.say: Now, pro tip. Give the key the least privileges it needs, or your sysadmin is going to get mad at you.
For done videos, that's Text to Speech, Voices with write access, Sound Effects, Music Generation, and User. Leave the rest at No Access.
Hark gave his full access, for simplicity. Please don't tell his sysadmin.
But by the time this video is out, Hark will have given his key least privileges too, because Hark follows best practices. Don't worry, sysadmin.
And keep Auto-disable if leaked turned on. If the key ever shows up in a public GitHub repo, ElevenLabs tries to switch it off for you.
Step four. Put the key in your terminal.
Ask Claude Code to set up a global environment variable called ElevenLabs API key.
lines.tts: Ask Claude Code to set up a global environment variable called ElevenLabs A P I key.

lines.say: But don't paste the key into the chat. Claude Code opened the zshrc file, and Hark pasted the key in himself.
lines.tts: But don't paste the key into the chat. Claude Code opened the Z S H R C file, and Hark pasted the key in himself.

lines.say: Restart the terminal, and ask Claude Code to check. It confirms the key is set, without printing it.
lines.tts: Restart the terminal, and ask Claude Code to check. It confirms the key is set, without printing it.

lines.say: Step five. Let it cook.
Hark gave Claude Code his SSW TV playlist and asked it to clone his voice.
lines.tts: Hark gave Claude Code his S S W TV playlist and asked it to clone his voice.

lines.say: It pulled the audio with yt-dlp, kept only the clean bits where Hark is talking, and made the clone with one API call.
lines.tts: It pulled the audio with Y T D L P, kept only the clean bits where Hark is talking, and made the clone with one A P I call.

lines.say: And here I am, in Hark's voice library. Isn't it cool?
A fair bit of disclaimer. Only clone your own voice, or one you have permission for.
Now, every time a PBI is done, Hark asks Claude Code for a done video.
lines.tts: Now, every time a P B I is done, Hark asks Claude Code for a done video.

lines.say: It writes the script in the SSW structure, makes the narration in his voice, and builds the video.
lines.tts: It writes the script in the S S W structure, makes the narration in his voice, and builds the video.

lines.say: It's not perfect yet. The first video had no SSW lower thirds and no background music.
lines.tts: It's not perfect yet. The first video had no S S W lower thirds and no background music.

lines.say: This one has both, and even the music is made by ElevenLabs.
Quick recap. Make an account, pick Starter, create a named API key with least privileges, set it in your terminal, and let Claude Code clone your voice.
